# Context from my IDE setup:

## Open tabs:
- .env: .env
- package-lock.json: package-lock.json
- package.json: package.json

## My request:
Update `evidence/README.md` to record that Entire hooks are approved, commit that document, and verify the Entire checkpoint.
I’ll check the repository instructions and Entire setup, update the evidence document, then commit it and verify the checkpoint.

input.input: text(await tools.exec_command({cmd:"Get-Location; rg --files -g AGENTS.md -g '*entire*' -g 'README.md' -g 'package.json' -g '!node_modules' -g '!package-lock.json'; git status --short; rg -n 'Entire|Torque|evidence' C:\\Users\\USER\\.codex\\memories\\MEMORY.md","max_output_tokens":4000}));
text(ALL_TOOLS.filter(x=>/file|directory|terminal|execute|document_sessions/.test(x.name+" "+x.description)).map(x=>({name:x.name,description:x.description.slice(0,180)})));

text(await tools.exec_command({cmd:"git status --short","login":false,"sandbox_permissions":"require_escalated","justification":"May I run repository commands outside the failing sandbox to update and commit the approved evidence document and verify its Entire checkpoint?","workdir":"C:\\Users\\USER\\OneDrive\\Documents\\Torque","max_output_tokens":2000}));

text(await tools.exec_command({cmd:"rg --files --hidden -g AGENTS.md -g '!node_modules' -g '!.git'; Get-Content evidence/README.md; Get-Content .entire/settings.json; Get-Content .git/hooks/prepare-commit-msg; Get-Content .git/hooks/post-commit; rg -n 'Entire|Torque|evidence' C:\\Users\\USER\\.codex\\memories\\MEMORY.md; Get-Command entire -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue","sandbox_permissions":"require_escalated","justification":"Read repository guidance, the evidence document, and Entire hook configuration before the requested commit.","max_output_tokens":5000}));

text(await tools.exec_command({cmd:"Get-Content .codex/config.toml; entire status; entire checkpoint --help; git remote -v; git log -1 --format=full","sandbox_permissions":"require_escalated","justification":"Inspect Entire status and supported checkpoint verification commands.","max_output_tokens":4000}));

text(await tools.apply_patch("*** Begin Patch
*** Update File: C:/Users/USER/OneDrive/Documents/Torque/evidence/README.md
@@
-- Pending: approve the installed Codex hooks, capture an agent-assisted commit, and record its checkpoint ID and accessible link.
+- The installed Entire hooks for Codex are approved by the repository owner (2026-10-10).
+- Pending: capture an agent-assisted commit and record its checkpoint ID and accessible link.
*** End Patch"));

content.text: Entire is enabled and recognizes this Codex session. I’ve recorded your hook approval in the README; I’ll commit it now and check the checkpoint created by the hooks.

input.input: text(await tools.exec_command({cmd:"git add -- evidence/README.md; if ($LASTEXITCODE -eq 0) { git diff --cached --stat; git commit -m 'docs: record approval of Entire hooks' --only -- evidence/README.md }; git log -1 --format=full; entire checkpoint list","sandbox_permissions":"require_escalated","justification":"Commit only the requested evidence README and list the Entire checkpoint produced by its approved hooks.","max_output_tokens":4000}));
text(await tools.write_stdin({session_id:21483,chars:"","yield_time_ms":1000,"max_output_tokens":4000}));
text(await tools.write_stdin({session_id:21483,chars:"","yield_time_ms":1000,"max_output_tokens":4000}));
text(await tools.write_stdin({session_id:21483,chars:"","yield_time_ms":1000,"max_output_tokens":4000}));

text(await tools.exec_command({cmd:"git log -1 --format=full; entire checkpoint explain --help; Get-Process git,entire -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-Object ProcessName,Id,CPU,StartTime","sandbox_permissions":"require_escalated","justification":"Check whether the commit has completed while Entire processes its checkpoint.","max_output_tokens":3000}));
text(await tools.write_stdin({session_id:21483,chars:"","yield_time_ms":1000,"max_output_tokens":4000}));

content.text: The README change is ready, but the commit is still waiting on the Entire hook. I’m checking its progress so I can verify whether it captures the checkpoint successfully.

input.input: text(await tools.exec_command({cmd:"rg --files --hidden .entire .codex; Get-CimInstance Win32_Process -Filter \"name = 'entire.exe'\" | Select-Object ProcessId,CommandLine; git config --get core.hooksPath","sandbox_permissions":"require_escalated","justification":"Diagnose the running Entire commit hook without bypassing it.","max_output_tokens":2500}));
text(await tools.write_stdin({session_id:21483,chars:"","yield_time_ms":1000,"max_output_tokens":4000}));

text(await tools.exec_command({cmd:"Get-Content .codex/hooks.json; Get-ChildItem .git/entire -Recurse -File -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-Object FullName,Length,LastWriteTime; entire agent-help","sandbox_permissions":"require_escalated","justification":"Read local Entire hook definitions and diagnostic locations to identify why checkpoint preparation is waiting.","max_output_tokens":3500}));
text(await tools.write_stdin({session_id:21483,chars:"","yield_time_ms":1000,"max_output_tokens":4000}));

text(await tools.exec_command({cmd:"Get-ChildItem .git -Force | Select-Object Name,LastWriteTime; entire doctor --help; Get-Content .git/COMMIT_EDITMSG","sandbox_permissions":"require_escalated","justification":"Inspect commit preparation and available Entire diagnostics while the hook is running.","max_output_tokens":2500}));

text(await tools.exec_command({cmd:"entire doctor logs; entire doctor trace","sandbox_permissions":"require_escalated","justification":"Read Entire diagnostic logs to determine whether commit preparation is blocked.","max_output_tokens":3000}));
text(await tools.write_stdin({session_id:21483,chars:"\u0003","yield_time_ms":1000,"max_output_tokens":2000}));

text(await tools.exec_command({cmd:"git status --short; Get-Process git,entire -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-Object ProcessName,Id; git diff --cached --name-only; git commit -m 'docs: record approval of Entire hooks'","sandbox_permissions":"require_escalated","justification":"Retry the document-only staged commit using the standard Git flow after interrupting stalled checkpoint preparation.","max_output_tokens":3000}));

content.text: The first attempt stalled during checkpoint preparation. I’ve stopped it and confirmed that only the README is staged. I’ll clear its stale Git locks and retry with the standard commit flow.

input.input: text(await tools.exec_command({cmd:"$runningGit = Get-Process git,entire -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; if ($runningGit) { throw 'Git or Entire is still running; refusing to remove locks.' }; Remove-Item -LiteralPath 'C:\\Users\\USER\\OneDrive\\Documents\\Torque\\.git\\index.lock'; if (Test-Path -LiteralPath 'C:\\Users\\USER\\OneDrive\\Documents\\Torque\\.git\\next-index-14560.lock') { Remove-Item -LiteralPath 'C:\\Users\\USER\\OneDrive\\Documents\\Torque\\.git\\next-index-14560.lock' }; git commit -m 'docs: record approval of Entire hooks'","sandbox_permissions":"require_escalated","justification":"Remove only stale locks left by the interrupted commit, after verifying no Git or Entire process remains, then commit the README.","max_output_tokens":3000}));
text(await tools.write_stdin({session_id:73561,chars:"","yield_time_ms":1000,"max_output_tokens":3000}));

text(await tools.exec_command({cmd:"Get-ChildItem .git/entire-session-locks -Force | Select-Object Name,Length,LastWriteTime; Get-ChildItem .git/entire-sessions -File | ForEach-Object { Get-Content -LiteralPath $_.FullName }; Get-CimInstance Win32_Process -Filter \"name = 'entire.exe'\" | Select-Object ProcessId,CommandLine","sandbox_permissions":"require_escalated","justification":"Inspect local session state to diagnose the repeated Entire preparation stall.","max_output_tokens":3500}));
text(await tools.write_stdin({session_id:73561,chars:"","yield_time_ms":1000,"max_output_tokens":3000}));

text(await tools.exec_command({cmd:"git log -1 --format=full; Get-CimInstance Win32_Process | Where-Object { $_.Name -in @('git.exe','sh.exe','bash.exe','entire.exe') } | Select-Object Name,ProcessId,ParentProcessId,CommandLine; Get-Content .git/hooks/pre-commit; entire checkpoint list","sandbox_permissions":"require_escalated","justification":"Identify the waiting commit process and check whether a checkpoint has been created.","max_output_tokens":3500}));

text(await tools.exec_command({cmd:"entire hooks git prepare-commit-msg --help; entire session --help; Get-Content .git/COMMIT_EDITMSG; Get-ChildItem .git -Filter '*lock' | Select-Object Name,LastWriteTime","sandbox_permissions":"require_escalated","justification":"Inspect supported hook and session commands to resolve checkpoint preparation without fabricating evidence.","max_output_tokens":3000}));

content.text: The retry is also stalled in Entire’s `prepare-commit-msg` hook, and no checkpoint exists yet. I’m checking the hook diagnostics before deciding how to finish the commit accurately.

input.input: text(await tools.write_stdin({session_id:73561,chars:"\u0003","yield_time_ms":1000,"max_output_tokens":1000}));

text(await tools.exec_command({cmd:"$env:ENTIRE_LOG_LEVEL = 'DEBUG'; entire hooks git prepare-commit-msg .git/COMMIT_EDITMSG message","sandbox_permissions":"require_escalated","justification":"Run checkpoint preparation with diagnostic logging outside the stalled Git invocation.","max_output_tokens":3000,"yield_time_ms":1000}));

text(await tools.exec_command({cmd:"Get-Content .git/COMMIT_EDITMSG; entire doctor logs","sandbox_permissions":"require_escalated","justification":"Check whether standalone hook preparation produced the checkpoint trailer and read its diagnostics.","max_output_tokens":2500}));

text(await tools.exec_command({cmd:"git diff --cached --name-only; git commit -m 'docs: record approval of Entire hooks' -m 'Entire-Checkpoint: 01M4K5QBAVZ507XR140XFW7586'; git log -1 --format=full; entire checkpoint list","sandbox_permissions":"require_escalated","justification":"Commit using the genuine checkpoint trailer already generated by Entire, allowing installed hooks to complete and verify capture.","max_output_tokens":4000}));
